## Quick start

1. Click any pad (or press Z, X, C, V…) — the factory kit is already loaded.
2. Press PLAY START (or Space). A demo beat plays in Sequence 01; the green column is the playhead.
3. Click empty cells in the Pattern Sequencer to add hits; click lit cells to remove them. Drag to paint.
4. Press OVER DUB while playing and tap pads in time — your hits are written into the pattern.
5. Drag a WAV/MP3 from your computer onto a pad to replace its sound.
6. Press MODE, then PAD6 (TRIM) to cut the sound, or PAD7 (PROGRAM) to tune and shape it.
7. Your work autosaves in this browser. MODE → PAD3 (SAVE) exports a project file or a WAV.

- Audio starts on your first click or key press — browsers block sound until you interact with the page.
- Use Chrome or Edge for MIDI controllers (Web MIDI). Everything else works in Firefox and Safari too.
- For the tightest timing, close other heavy tabs; the sequencer schedules ahead so short hiccups don’t affect playback.

## Every button on the machine

### Left — Q-Link

- **Q1 / Q2 sliders** — Live controllers for the selected pad. Each slider is mapped to one parameter (shown under it: TUNE, CUTOFF, DECAY…). Moving it sets that parameter instantly.
- **AFTER** — Cycles the parameter its slider controls: tune → cutoff → resonance → decay → attack → level → pan → start → end → reverb → delay → fine. Set targets directly in MODE → PAD1 (SLIDER).

### Centre — screen and pads

- **LCD screen** — Shows the current mode. Click a field to select it (it turns dark), then turn the DATA wheel, scroll your mouse, or drag up/down on it to change the value. Hold SHIFT for bigger jumps. Drop audio files here to load them from the selected pad onward.
- **F1 – F6** — Soft keys. Their job changes per screen and is printed in the boxes along the bottom of the LCD, directly above each key.
- **Pads 1–16** — Play the sample assigned to that pad in the active bank. Hitting near the top of a pad plays louder (velocity). Drop an audio file on a pad to load it. With MODE lit, a pad opens the screen printed above it instead of playing.

### Right — knobs, bank and level

- **REC GAIN** — Input level for sampling from a microphone / line in (RECORD screen). Drag up/down or scroll. Double-click resets.
- **MAIN VOLUME** — Master output level. Also affects WAV exports.
- **PAD BANK A / B / C / D** — Switch which 16 of the 64 pads the pads and the sequencer rows show. The green LED marks the active bank.
- **FULL LEVEL** — Every pad hit plays at maximum velocity (127), regardless of where you hit.
- **16 LEVELS** — Spreads the selected pad across all 16 pads: either 16 velocities (soft → hard) or 16 pitches (−4 to +11 semitones). Choose which in MODE → PAD10 (OTHER) → 16Lvl. Press again to turn off.
- **NEXT SEQ** — Go to the next sequence (SHIFT + NEXT SEQ = previous). While playing it is queued (LED blinks) and switches at the end of the current loop.
- **TRACK MUTE** — While lit, pads mute/unmute their sequencer tracks instead of playing (muted pads show striped). SHIFT + pad solos the track.

### Right — data section

- **TAP TEMPO / NOTE REPEAT** — Tap 2+ times in time to set the BPM. Hold it while holding a pad for NOTE REPEAT (the pad re-fires at the T.C. rate, e.g. 1/16). SHIFT + TAP latches note repeat on/off.
- **DATA wheel** — Changes the highlighted LCD field. Drag around it, scroll over it, or focus it and use the arrow keys.
- **ERASE** — Hold ERASE and a pad: while playing, that pad’s hits are deleted as the playhead passes them; while stopped, the pad’s whole track is cleared. UNDO SEQ brings it back.
- **MODE** — Press, then press a pad to open the screen printed above that pad (e.g. PAD6 = TRIM). Press MODE again to cancel.
- **UNDO SEQ** — Undo the last sequence edit (painting, recording, clearing, shifting…). Up to 40 levels.
- **Cursor ▲ ◀ ▶ ▼** — Move the highlight between LCD fields. The computer’s arrow keys do the same.
- **MAIN** — Return to the MAIN screen (sequence, tempo, swing, length).
- **WINDOW** — Enlarges the LCD to a big editing view (great for trimming waveforms). Press again, click outside it, or press Esc to close.

### Right — locate and transport

- **SHIFT** — Hold to modify other controls: bigger value jumps, previous sequence, latch note repeat, solo in TRACK MUTE, swap instead of copy pads. The Shift key on your keyboard works too.
- **◀◀ BAR / BAR ▶▶** — While stopped, move the start position one bar back or forward. PLAY starts from there.
- **◀ STEP / STEP ▶** — While stopped, move the start position one step back or forward.
- **PLAY START** — Play the sequence from step 1.
- **REC** — Record with overwrite: on the first loop, existing hits are wiped as the playhead passes and replaced with what you play; then it switches to OVER DUB automatically. Press before PLAY to arm (LED blinks).
- **OVER DUB** — Record on top of what is already there. Hits snap to the nearest step (or keep their exact feel with T.C. off).
- **STOP** — Stop playback and recording. Press again while stopped to silence every ringing sound (panic).
- **PLAY** — Play from the located position (see LOCATE).

## Pads and the MODE screens

Pads play sounds. Hitting near the top edge is louder; the computer keys Z X C V / A S D F / Q W E R / 1 2 3 4
are the four pad rows from bottom to top. There are four banks (A–D) of 16 pads — 64 sounds in total.

Press **MODE**, then a pad, to open the screen printed above it:

| Pad | Screen |
|---|---|
| **PAD1 — SLIDER** | Choose what Q1 / Q2 control |
| **PAD2 — LOAD** | Load files, the factory kit, projects and kits |
| **PAD3 — SAVE** | Export project / kit, bounce WAV, new project |
| **PAD5 — RECORD** | Sample from mic / line in, or resample the main output |
| **PAD6 — TRIM** | Waveform editing: start / end, normalize, crop, chop |
| **PAD7 — PROGRAM** | Pad sound design: level, tune, envelope, filter, play mode, retrigger, copy |
| **PAD8 — MIXER** | Per-pad level, pan, effect sends, mute, solo |
| **PAD9 — MIDI/SYNC** | Pick a MIDI keyboard / pad controller |
| **PAD10 — OTHER** | Metronome, count-in, timing correct, note repeat rate, 16 levels |
| **PAD12 — EFFECT** | Delay, reverb and master compressor |
| **PAD13 — SEQ EDIT** | Sequence length, resolution, swing, copy, double, clear |
| **PAD14 — STEP EDIT** | Track tools: shift timing, copy track, quantize |
| **PAD16 — SONG** | Chain sequences into a song |

Pad modifiers: **FULL LEVEL** (always loudest), **16 LEVELS** (one sound over 16 velocities or pitches),
**TRACK MUTE** (pads mute tracks), **ERASE** (hold + pad deletes hits), **TAP TEMPO** held (note repeat).

## Screens

Select a field by clicking it, then turn the DATA wheel, scroll, or drag up/down. F1–F6 run the actions in the
boxes along the bottom of the screen. WINDOW enlarges the screen.

### MAIN

*Open:* MAIN button

Home screen. The top line counts Bar.Beat.Step while playing.

| Field | What it does |
|---|---|
| **Seq** | Active sequence 01–16 (queued while playing) |
| **BPM** | Tempo, 30–300 |
| **Len** | Sequence length: 8 to 64 steps in jumps of 8 |
| **Res** | What one step is worth: 1/8, 1/16, 1/16 triplet or 1/32 |
| **Swing** | 50% = straight, ~66% = triplet shuffle, 75% = heavy |
| **T.C.** | Note-repeat / timing-correct rate |
| **Pad** | Selected pad (the one the edit screens work on) |
| **Rec** | Recording status |

| F-key | Action |
|---|---|
| `T.C.` | Cycle the note-repeat rate (1/4 … 1/64) |
| `CLICK` | Metronome on/off |
| `SEQ-` | Previous sequence |
| `SEQ+` | Next sequence |
| `MUTE` | Toggle TRACK MUTE mode |
| `SOUND` | Jump to PROGRAM for the selected pad |

### TRIM (PAD6)

*Open:* MODE → PAD6

Set which part of the sample plays. Drag the S (start) and E (end) flags on the waveform, or edit St / End with the DATA wheel. Hold SHIFT for 25 ms jumps.

| Field | What it does |
|---|---|
| **St / End** | Start and end of the playing region, in milliseconds |
| **Len** | Length of the region |
| **Smpl** | Sample length, rate, mono/stereo |
| **Pad** | Which pad you are editing |
| **Reverse** | Play the region backwards |
| **Slices (CHOP)** | How many pieces to cut, 2–16 |
| **Mode (CHOP)** | EQUAL = even slices, TRANSIENT = cut at each hit in the audio |
| **Sens (CHOP)** | Transient sensitivity — lower finds more hits |
| **Dest (CHOP)** | Which bank receives the slices on pads 1, 2, 3… |

| F-key | Action |
|---|---|
| `ZOOM` | Zoom the waveform 1× → 32× around the region |
| `NORM` | Normalize: makes the sample as loud as possible without clipping (new copy) |
| `CROP` | Throw away audio outside the region (press twice to confirm) |
| `CHOP` | Open the chop page to slice the region across pads |
| `RESET` | Region back to the whole sample |
| `PLAY` | Audition the pad |
| `BACK` | Leave the chop page |
| `DO IT` | Apply the chop / copy |

### PROGRAM (PAD7)

*Open:* MODE → PAD7, or SOUND on MAIN

Sound design for the selected pad, in five pages picked with F1–F5.

| Field | What it does |
|---|---|
| **Level** | Pad volume |
| **Tune / Fine** | Pitch in semitones (±36) and cents (±100) |
| **Attack** | Fade-in time |
| **Decay** | How fast the sound dies away; OFF = full length |
| **VelSns** | How much hit strength changes loudness |
| **Pan** | Left / right position |
| **Filter** | OFF, LOW (darker), HIGH (thinner) or BAND |
| **Cutoff / Reso** | Filter frequency and resonance (peak) |
| **EnvAmt / EnvDcy** | Filter envelope: each hit opens (+) or closes (−) the filter by this many octaves, then sweeps back over EnvDcy |
| **Vel>Flt** | Softer hits sound darker |
| **Mode** | ONE SHOT plays the whole region; NOTE ON plays only while the pad is held |
| **Poly** | POLY lets hits overlap; MONO cuts the previous hit |
| **Loop** | Loop the region while held (NOTE ON mode) |
| **MuteGrp** | Pads in the same group cut each other off (e.g. open + closed hi-hat) |
| **Hits / Rate / Fade / Pitch** | Retrigger: every hit becomes a roll of N hits at Rate, each quieter (Fade) and re-pitched (Pitch) |
| **To pad** | Destination for COPY / SWAP |

| F-key | Action |
|---|---|
| `AMP` | Level, tune, envelope, pan page |
| `FILTER` | Filter page |
| `MODE` | Play mode, polyphony, loop, mute group, reverse page |
| `RETRIG` | Retrigger (stutter / roll) page |
| `COPY` | Copy or swap this pad with another |
| `PLAY` | Audition the pad |
| `DO IT` | Copy the pad to "To pad" (SHIFT + DO IT swaps them) |

### MIXER (PAD8)

*Open:* MODE → PAD8

Faders for the 16 pads of the bank. Click a strip to select that pad.

| Field | What it does |
|---|---|
| **Level / Pan** | Pad volume and stereo position |
| **Delay / Reverb** | How much of the pad is sent to each effect |
| **Mute / Solo** | Silence the track / hear only soloed tracks |
| **Master** | Main output level |

| F-key | Action |
|---|---|
| `BANK-` | Previous bank |
| `BANK+` | Next bank |
| `MUTE` | Mute the selected pad |
| `SOLO` | Solo the selected pad |
| `RESET` | Reset level, pan and sends |
| `PLAY` | Audition the pad |

### EFFECT (PAD12)

*Open:* MODE → PAD12

Two send effects shared by all pads plus a master compressor. Send pads to them in MIXER.

| Field | What it does |
|---|---|
| **D.Time** | Delay time, locked to the tempo (D = dotted, T = triplet) |
| **D.Fdbk** | Number of echoes |
| **D.Tone** | Darkens the echoes |
| **D.Rtn / R.Rtn** | Effect return levels |
| **R.Size** | Reverb length in seconds |
| **R.PreD** | Gap before the reverb starts |
| **Comp** | Glue compressor on the master output |

| F-key | Action |
|---|---|
| `COMP` | Compressor on/off |
| `MIXER` | Go to MIXER |
| `PLAY` | Audition the pad |

### RECORD (PAD5)

*Open:* MODE → PAD5

Make new samples. MIC records your microphone / line input (the browser will ask for permission). MAIN OUT resamples the machine itself — e.g. bounce a whole beat onto one pad and chop it.

| Field | What it does |
|---|---|
| **Input** | MIC / LINE IN or MAIN OUT (resample) |
| **Target** | Pad that receives the new sample |
| **Gain** | Mic input level (same as the REC GAIN knob) |
| **Length** | Resample only: FREE (stop by hand) or exactly 1–8 loops of the sequence, started and stopped on the beat |

| F-key | Action |
|---|---|
| `ARM` | Open the input; the meter starts moving |
| `DISARM` | Close the input |
| `REC` | Start recording (synced resample also starts playback) |
| `STOP` | Stop and keep the take (silence is trimmed for mic takes) |
| `TRIM` | Go to TRIM to tidy the new sample |
| `PLAY` | Audition the pad |

### LOAD (PAD2)

*Open:* MODE → PAD2

Get sounds in. Drag-and-drop works everywhere: onto a pad, or onto the screen to fill pads in order.

| Field | What it does |
|---|---|
| **Pad** | Pad to load into |
| **Sample** | Re-use any sample already in memory on this pad |

| F-key | Action |
|---|---|
| `FILE` | Pick an audio file for the selected pad |
| `MULTI` | Pick several files — they fill pads from the selected one onward |
| `KIT` | Load the built-in factory drum kit into the current bank |
| `OPEN` | Open a project (.mpcweb) or a kit (.mpckit) |
| `CLEAR` | Remove the sample from the pad |
| `PLAY` | Audition the pad |

### SAVE (PAD3)

*Open:* MODE → PAD3

Everything autosaves in your browser. Use these to back up, share or export audio.

| Field | What it does |
|---|---|
| **Loops** | How many times the sequence repeats in a WAV bounce (song mode bounces the whole chain) |

| F-key | Action |
|---|---|
| `EXPORT` | Download the full project with samples (.mpcweb) |
| `KIT` | Download just the pads and samples (.mpckit) |
| `BOUNCE` | Render the sequence / song to a WAV file |
| `NEW` | Start over with the factory kit (press twice) |

### SEQ EDIT (PAD13) / STEP EDIT (PAD14)

*Open:* MODE → PAD13 (sequence page) or PAD14 (track page)

Sequence-wide settings and per-track timing tools.

| Field | What it does |
|---|---|
| **Seq / Len / Res / Swing** | Same as on MAIN |
| **CopyTo** | Destination sequence for COPY |
| **Copy to** | Destination pad for CPYTRK |
| **T.C.** | Timing Correct: ON snaps recorded hits to the grid, OFF keeps your exact timing |

| F-key | Action |
|---|---|

| `CLRTRK` | Wipe the selected pad’s track |
| `COPY` | Copy this sequence into CopyTo |
| `DOUBLE` | Double the length and duplicate the hits (8 → 16 → 32 → 64) |
| `UNDO` | Undo the last edit |
| `TRACK` | Open the track page |
| `◀SHIFT` | Move the selected track one step earlier (wraps around) |
| `SHIFT▶` | Move the selected track one step later |
| `CPYTRK` | Copy the selected track onto another pad |
| `QUANT` | Snap every off-grid hit in the sequence onto the grid |
| `SEQ` | Back to the sequence page |

*Open:* MODE → PAD16

Chain sequences. With Song ON, PLAY runs through the steps in order and loops.

*Open:* MODE → PAD9

## Pattern sequencer

The panel to the right of the MPC.

- **REC / OVERDUB / STOP / PLAY** — Same as the transport buttons on the MPC. PLAY here always starts from step 1.
- **Sequence buttons 01–16** — Pick a sequence. A dot means it has hits. While playing, the choice blinks and switches at the end of the loop.
- **Steps 8–64** — Sequence length. With 1/16 resolution, 16 steps = 1 bar and 64 steps = 4 bars.
- **Resolution** — Note value of one step: 1/8, 1/16, 1/16T (triplets) or 1/32.
- **Swing** — Pushes every second step late for groove. 50% = straight.
- **Tempo** — BPM. Type a value or use TAP TEMPO.
- **T.C. ON / OFF** — Timing Correct. ON: recorded hits snap to steps. OFF: they keep your exact timing and show as narrow, nudged blocks in the grid.
- **Quantize** — Snap all off-grid hits in this sequence to the grid.
- **Double** — Double the length, copying the hits into the new half.
- **Copy to…** — Copy this whole sequence into another slot.
- **Clear** — Remove every hit in this sequence (undoable).
- **Undo** — Undo the last sequence edit.
- **Song mode** — ON: playback follows the chain of sequences to the right instead of looping one.
- **Song chain** — The order sequences play in. × removes a step; “+ Seq NN” appends the current sequence.
- **Bank A–D** — Which 16 pads the rows show (same as PAD BANK).
- **Track name** — Pad number and sample. Click to select the pad for editing; the red LED flashes when it plays.
- **M** — Mute this track.
- **S** — Solo — only soloed tracks play.
- **Step grid** — Click to add/remove a hit, drag to paint several. Shift-click adds an accent (velocity 127). Right-click a hit to cycle its velocity 127 → 100 → 70 → 40. Bar height and brightness show velocity.
- **Velocity lane** — Velocities of the selected track. Drag up/down across the bars to draw them.
- **◀ shift ▶** — Move the selected track one step earlier or later.
- **GUIDE** — Open this guide. Shortcut: ? key.

## How to…

### Program a beat from scratch

1. Pick an empty sequence (e.g. 02) in the Pattern Sequencer.
2. Choose the length (16 = 1 bar) and resolution (1/16 is the classic MPC grid).
3. Click cells to place kicks, snares and hats. Right-click hits to vary velocity.
4. Press PLAY START. Adjust Swing (54–62% feels great) and the tempo while it loops.

### Record live, finger-drumming style

1. Optional: MODE → PAD10 (OTHER) → Click ON and CountIn ON.
2. Press OVER DUB (or REC to replace), then PLAY START.
3. Play the pads or keys in time. Hits snap to steps; turn T.C. OFF to keep your exact feel.
4. Hold TAP TEMPO + a pad for machine-gun hi-hats (NOTE REPEAT).
5. Hold ERASE + a pad to remove its hits as they go by. UNDO SEQ if you slip.

### Chop a sample across the pads

1. Drop a drum loop or vocal onto a pad.
2. MODE → PAD6 (TRIM). Drag S / E to the part you want.
3. Press CHOP. Set Slices (e.g. 8) and Mode: EQUAL for loops, TRANSIENT for one-shots.
4. Pick a destination bank in Dest, press DO IT — the slices land on pads 1, 2, 3…

### Resample your beat

1. MODE → PAD5 (RECORD). Set Input to MAIN OUT and Length to 1 (one loop).
2. Choose a Target pad, press ARM, then REC. The sequence plays and is captured exactly on the beat.
3. The loop is now one sample — chop it, reverse it, pitch it down.

### Sample from a microphone

1. MODE → PAD5 (RECORD), Input MIC / LINE IN. Pick a Target pad.
2. Press ARM and allow microphone access. Set REC GAIN so the meter peaks below 0 dB.
3. Press REC, perform, press STOP. Silence before and after is trimmed automatically.

### Shape a pad’s sound

1. Select the pad (hit it), then MODE → PAD7 (PROGRAM).
2. AMP: Tune an 808 down, shorten Decay for tight drums.
3. FILTER: LOW + EnvAmt +3 and EnvDcy 150 ms gives a plucky “pew”.
4. MODE: put open and closed hats in the same MuteGrp so they choke.
5. RETRIG: Hits 4, Rate 1/32, Pitch +1 for a rising roll.

### Arrange a song and export it

1. Build several sequences (intro, verse, hook…).
2. In the sequencer, turn Song mode ON and add sequences to the chain with “+ Seq”.
3. MODE → PAD3 (SAVE) → BOUNCE renders the whole song to a WAV.
4. EXPORT saves the full project to move it to another computer.

## Keyboard and MIDI

| Key | Does |
|---|---|
| `1 2 3 4` | PAD13 – PAD16 |
| `Q W E R` | PAD9 – PAD12 |
| `A S D F` | PAD5 – PAD8 |
| `Z X C V` | PAD1 – PAD4 |
| `Shift + pad key` | Accent (velocity 127) |
| `Space` | Play / stop |
| `Arrow keys` | Move the LCD cursor |
| `, and .  (or − and =)` | Decrease / increase the highlighted field (Shift = bigger steps) |
| `Esc` | Cancel MODE, close the enlarged screen or this guide |
| `?` | Open the guide |

MIDI controllers: notes 37–52 (C#1–E2, the MPC default) play PAD1–16 of the active bank with velocity. Choose a
device in MODE → PAD9 (MIDI/SYNC).

## Saving and exporting

- Everything — pads, samples, sequences, effects, settings — autosaves to this browser (IndexedDB) a moment after each change, and is restored when you come back.
- Browser storage belongs to this browser on this computer. Clearing site data deletes it, so export anything you care about.
- SAVE → EXPORT downloads a .mpcweb project file containing every sample. LOAD → OPEN brings it back on any computer.
- SAVE → KIT downloads only the pads and their samples (.mpckit) so you can reuse a kit in other projects; loading a kit keeps your sequences.
- SAVE → BOUNCE renders the current sequence (or the whole song in song mode) to a WAV file, including effects.
- Samples that are not on any pad are discarded the next time the page loads.
